issues.title: Truncated JSON Schema
issues.why: The normative JSON Schema file (schemas/powershell.schema.json) is truncated at the end of the provided context, leaving the 'credentials' object and 'wpPlugins' properties incomplete.
issues.fix: Ensure the full JSON Schema is provided or reference the complete schema structure in 01-configuration-schema.md.

issues.title: Missing External Script Context
issues.why: The spec references 'upload-plugin-v2.ps1' and 'upload-plugin-U-Q.ps1' as active components for the -u and -q flags, but these scripts are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Add a 'Mock/Stub' section for these scripts or explicitly define their CLI interface (parameters/exit codes) in 02-script-reference.md.

issues.title: Winget Availability Edge Case
issues.why: Step 2 (Prerequisites) relies on winget for auto-install, but if winget is missing (e.g., older Windows Server), the fallback behavior is mentioned but not codified with an exit code.
issues.fix: Explicitly map 'Winget Not Found' to Exit Code 1 (ERR_PREREQUISITES) in the Step 2 contract table.
